instances._site_build_comment: `extends: document-folio` (folio-assistant-core templates/site-presets/, litlfred/cat-harness-tools#2345): the shared document-folio steps run first (document, library, review sheet, glossary, bibliography, ArchiMate, context) and the publish refuses on any broken internal link. Only this folio's own steps are listed here; its package.json site:document keeps --downloads.
instances._site_comment: `site:context` builds the JSON-LD context the KG nodes name (ns/context/v1.jsonld under iriBase) into the site, so it is published with it (cat-harness-tools#1052); nothing else writes it, so nothing is kept.
